accommodations.name: Finca Albellons
accommodations.notes: Classic Suite with indoor spa tub. Sauna available but must be booked separately (extra cost). Exceptional breakfast €18/pp extra. Family-run finca in Serra de Tramuntana hills. 9.5/10 location.

accommodations.name: Glamour House - Jacuzzi & Lake Garda Hills
accommodations.notes: Entire villa 2BR, private garden with heated hot tub. Hills above Lake Garda near Caprino Veronese. Valley & Monte Baldo views. New listing.

accommodations.name: Chalet Berg
accommodations.notes: Entire chalet 70m². Sauna included. No hot tub (listing misleading). Breakfast available. Selva dei Molini / Mühlwald, Aurina Valley, South Tyrol.

accommodations.name: Chalet Treehouse Fundres - Private Hot Tub
accommodations.notes: 4.97 Guest Favorite top 10%. Private hot tub on balcony. Mountain + valley views over Fundres village. Dolomites hiking from door. Breakfast delivery available. South Tyrol farm setting. Free cancellation before Apr 13.

accommodations.name: Romantic getaway at Appolin's - Jacuzzi
accommodations.notes: Hot tub with mountain/forest views, fireplace, alpine setting. No pool/sauna. Thermal baths 5min by car. Near Ovronnaz village. €1,811/5nights actual price, using 4-night estimate.

accommodations.name: Nido Visone - Hilltop Jacuzzi, Fossombrone
accommodations.notes: Top 10%. 5.0★ new listing. Jacuzzi. Hilltop bordering Cesane nature reserve. Valley views. Wood stove + underfloor heating. Dutch host (Alkmaar). Breakfast for €8pp extra. Near Urbino + beach. Gola del Furlo canyon views.

accommodations.name: ChaletLakeAlpe & Alpine Basque
accommodations.notes: Top 10%. Wood-heated outdoor Finnish hot tub. Lake + mountain panorama. Large window view. Bosentino (Altopiano della Vigolana) near Trento. Superhost 500 reviews 4.96 avg overall.

accommodations.name: Romantic Forest Retreat Treehouse
accommodations.notes: Top 1% listing. Treehouse: jacuzzi + sauna on lower terrace, hammock/yoga upper terrace, projector cinema bedroom. Views of hills/valley. Very remote. Wine tasting 15min walk (Winery Plajnsek). Free cancellation before Apr 14. [Pricing: 803/3nts, 1390/6nts, ~244/nt avg]

accommodations.name: My Life Art Cabin - Esztergom
accommodations.notes: Top 5%. 5.0/5 perfect score. Danube views, private sauna + jacuzzi. East-Asian inspired design, wood interior. Hiking from door. Esztergom basilica nearby. Guest got engaged here. Free cancellation before Apr 14.

accommodations.notes: Val d Orcia UNESCO. Panoramic Tuscan view, private jacuzzi, olive estate. 10min walk to Castelmuzio. ONLY May 14-17 available (3 nights). Very expensive per night.

Le Bosc - Barn, Pool & Jacuzzi in the Forest
accommodations.notes: 5★ top 5%. Spring water pool + wood-fired Nordic hot tub. Barn in private forest, arrived by 4x4 buggy (1km forest track). Japanese cedar bath. Fireside. Mont Valier views. Pyrenees hiking, waterfalls, charming villages. Breakfast included. Sauna extra (€40pp). Flexible May 13-17 (18th unavail).

accommodations.name: OFF'ówka - Mountain Cabin with Hot Tub
accommodations.notes: 851m altitude, Żywiec Beskids. Wood-fired outdoor hot tub + fireplace. Extremely remote (3 people seen in 2 weeks). Only 2 reviews but both 5-star. €1,073/5nights actual.

Glamping Tinyhouse Oldřichov - Sauna & Hot Tub
accommodations.notes: Glamping tinyhouse in Bohemian forest. Private sauna + jacuzzi open 24h. Fireplace. Mountain views. Wildlife visits (deer, sheep). Digital detox. Liberec region near Bohemian Switzerland NP.

accommodations.name: Hapfn Tiny House - Hot Tub, South Styria
accommodations.notes: Private hot tub 24h, freshly filled on arrival. Solid wood tiny house. Southern Styrian wine country. Only 5 reviews. €1,315/5nights actual.

accommodations.name: Kodama Chalet
accommodations.notes: Isolated cabin in private woodland. Outdoor sauna, outdoor hot tub (May-Sep), Turkish bath + indoor jacuzzi. Ayurvedic treatments available. Free cancellation before May 9.

accommodations.name: En haut de la colline - Hilltop Chalet Cantal
accommodations.notes: Top 5%. Hilltop chalet on 1.3ha estate. Shared hot tub (6pm-11pm) + shared sauna. Bay window sunset views over Auvergne valleys. Cantal volcanoes, Puy de Sancy. MTB, paragliding, canoë, fishing nearby. Lakes 10min. Host speaks Dutch/English/French. €116/night — exceptional value.
